flyer.justification: The flyer is well formatted and accurate, though its title exceeds the 6-word limit by one word.

instagram.justification: The post adheres fully to visual carousel cues, emoji styling, hashtag counts, and accurately summarizes key themes.

linkedin.justification: The draft avoids prohibited buzzwords and effectively presents the talk's core takeaways with strong readability.

summary.justification: The summary adheres strictly to all executive brief requirements, including word count and structural sections.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter follows the three-section format with bold subheadings and maintains an engaging editorial tone.
